newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JAPAN GIVES S.AFRICAN HOSPITALS 59 MLN RAND IN AID.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN GIVES S.AFRICAN HOSPITALS 59 MLN RAND IN AID.

text.p: The Japanese government said on Monday it has given South Africa aid grants of 59.13 million rand to improve the country's hospital medical facilities.
"The purpose of this financial assistance is to improve the provision of medical care services at public medical care facilities," said a statement from the Japanese embassy in Pretoria.
It will especially focus on providing aid for South Africa's rural areas, where medical facilities can be basic.
The aid accord will be signed on Tuesday by Japanese ambassador Yoshizo Konishi and Health Minister Nkosazana Zuma.
